axes_source: Read from data/brands/stripe.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #533AFD and the canvas #FFFFFF; contrast from the ink #0D253D on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #533AFD; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 4, 6, 8, 12, 16px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #533AFD reaches 6.19:1 on the canvas #FFFFFF, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
